items.question: How do I order?
items.answer: Download the app, pick a chef near you, choose a dish and pay. Your chef gets the order right away.

items.question: How far ahead should I order?
items.answer: Some chefs cook same-day; others take pre-orders the night before. Every dish shows its ready time.

items.question: Can I order from two chefs at once?
items.answer: One kitchen per order for now, so each chef can cook and pack yours properly.

items.question: How can I pay?
items.answer: GCash, Maya or card, all inside the app. No sending money to strangers.

items.question: Is there a delivery fee?
items.answer: Lalamove delivery has a fee you see before paying. Pickup from your chef is free.

items.question: Can I tip my chef?
items.answer: Yes. 100% of tips go to the chef.

items.question: How do you check chefs?
items.answer: ID check, a call with our team, and an in-person kitchen visit before anyone goes live.

items.question: What food safety standards do chefs follow?
items.answer: [Placeholder: permits, orientation and kitchen checklist details.]

items.question: What if something's wrong with my food?
items.answer: Report it in the app within 24 hours. A real person on our Cebu team will make it right.

items.question: How long does it take to start?
items.answer: Usually 1–2 weeks: a short call, a kitchen visit, an orientation, then you set up your menu.

items.question: Do I need a business permit?
items.answer: [Placeholder: permit requirements.] We walk you through it during onboarding.

items.question: Do I need special equipment?
items.answer: No. If you cook for your family now, your kitchen is probably ready.

items.question: How much does SupaChefs take?
items.answer: [Placeholder: fee %.] You set your own prices, and tips are 100% yours.

items.question: When do I get paid?
items.answer: [Placeholder: payout schedule] straight to your [GCash / bank].

items.question: Can I set a limit on orders?
items.answer: Yes. Set a daily cap and the app stops taking orders when you hit it.

items.question: Can I pause my kitchen?
items.answer: Anytime, from the app. No penalties.

items.question: Who handles customer complaints?
items.answer: Our Cebu team, together with you. You're never on your own.
